said on Monday that Brian Ezzell, VP of financial planning & analysis, treasurer, and investor relations, will become SVP and CFO, effective October 1, 2026.
He will succeed Amy Schwetz, who is leaving Flowserve for a leadership role at another company and will remain in her CFO role through September 30, 2026 to support the transition.

Ezzell has been Flowserve’s vice president, FP&A, treasurer, and investor relations since October 2024. Prior to joining Flowserve, he spent four years as vice president, enterprise FP&A at Kimberly-Clark.

title: Flowserve names Brian Ezzell as CFO as Amy Schwetz to depart
